candidates.name: CMD, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Runs a 'Doors & Division 10 Office' in North Las Vegas. Its 'Building / Bathroom Accessories & Specialties' line lists grab bars, towel dispensers and mirrors. Two gallery photos in that category have alt text describing a bathroom stall ('a metal stall in the middle of a bathroom'). No page names toilet partition installation as a service.
candidates.reason: A Las Vegas commercial millwork, doors and Division 10 firm with washroom accessories and stall photos in its gallery. Partition installation is likely but not stated as a service.
red_flags: No email listed; contact form only
Partition work shown only in gallery alt text

license.name: CMD, Inc.
license.registry: Nevada State Contractors Board license search (app.nvcontractorsboard.com)
license.license_type: C-26B Building Accessories and Specialties (lic. 0079462); also C-3B Finish Carpentry (0059714), C-14E Metal Doors and Windows (0076020), C-19 Installing Terrazzo and Marble (0080125)
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. NSCB search lists legal name C M D INC, NV Business ID NV20121598818, city Las Vegas NV, four licenses all Active: 0059714 C-3B, 0076020 C-14E, 0079462 C-26B, 0080125 C-19. The four numbers match the ones on cmdnv.com, which lists '59714 is Unlimited', '76020 is Unlimited', '0079462 $1Mil', '80125 Limit $245,000.00'. The site's company phone is (702) 990-4478. C-26B (Building Accessories and Specialties) is the classification that fits partition and accessory installation. cmdnv.com mentions bathroom accessories and specialties but not toilet partitions by name. The search results page gives only summary rows, and I didn't open the License Details page, so bond and limit details come from the company site, not the board. This search did not establish whether the company holds a City of Las Vegas business license, because no public city license lookup was found. A separate company, CMD FINISH CARPENTRY LLC (0092753), is unrelated.

candidates.name: Black Scale
candidates.partition_evidence: The site says 'Complete supply and installation of commercial restroom partition systems' in powder-coated steel, stainless, HDPE, phenolic and laminate, and the company calls itself a distributor for ASI, Hadrian and Bobrick.
candidates.reason: A genuine commercial Division 10 partition installer, but it's based in Scottsdale, about 300 miles from Las Vegas, and its listed service areas are all in Arizona. It's also a partition distributor, a buy-around risk.

candidates.name: Glass Guys LLC
candidates.partition_evidence: Services are frameless shower doors, bath enclosures, specialty glass, and glass doors and windows. The site doesn't mention toilet partitions or Division 10.
candidates.reason: A glass and shower-door company; no restroom partition work shown.

candidates.name: Western Partitions, Inc. (WPI)
candidates.partition_evidence: Core services are drywall, framing, acoustical, insulation, fireproofing, EIFS, doors/frames/hardware and similar. Toilet partitions and Division 10 are not listed; 'Partitions' in the name means interior walls.
candidates.reason: A large Oregon-based interiors subcontractor with a Las Vegas office, but it does wall systems, not restroom partitions.
red_flags: Name refers to wall partitions, not toilet partitions
HQ in Oregon; the Las Vegas office has no listed address or phone

candidates.name: Hearth & Home Specialties
candidates.partition_evidence: The website returned HTTP 429 on three attempts and a web search found nothing linking the company to partitions.
candidates.reason: No evidence of partition work could be verified (site blocked; the name suggests fireplace/hearth products). Recheck the site manually before discarding.

candidates.name: MBR Construction
candidates.partition_evidence: The website has only a title and no content; /about returns 404. A web search found nothing linking it to partitions or Division 10.
